messages:
linda: Heads-up: the telemetry reprocess kicked off at 02:10 and caused a spike in ingest-write latency. A couple of customer SLO alerts fired. We need a mitigation ASAP.

sam: saw it too — alerts from the SLA dashboard. looks like the new fast-replay path ran full-parallel. link: https://console/replays/veg/123

kate: that was the fast-path experiment for nearline aggregates. it bypassed tenant weight restrictions. my bad — config defaulted to ops-fast=true.

mike: sounds like we need both a routing-layer throttle and a CB in the console. replays should never be able to preempt live ingest beyond X% capacity.

anya: ops-bot: deploy #326-applier rolled to canary at 02:09 (applier changelist: increase replay parallelism) :warning:

kevin: quick mitigation proposal: enforce replay.parallelism per-shard <= 1 and add a global 'replay_concurrency_budget' gate. also circuit-breaker that trips if 5m ingest p90 > 250ms. We already surface ingest p90 in the console metrics.

sophia: UX: if we expose a circuit-breaker on the replay run modal, default to 'auto' for ops teams and 'on' for self-service? we should avoid adding a scary toggle for product users.

sam: API sketch: POST /console/replays { jobs: [...], circuit_breaker_policy: "auto" | "off" | "manual", prefer_cache: boolean }

linda: ops playbook question: when the cb trips does the run move to QUEUED or FAIL? i'd prefer QUEUED with a clear reason so support can triage.

kevin: QUEUED works. console should show reason: 'tripped: ingest_latency_p90>250ms'. we'll also surface last_tripped_by and tripped_at fields.

mike: fallback idea: when replay is gated, serve cached aggregates from prefix-KV with a 'staleness' badge. API flag prefer_cache=true would surface it. this avoids a hard outage for dashboards.

anya: technical note: cache-serving requires marking responses with cache_ttl and a `x-aggregate-stale-until` header. will need a small API bump.

sophia: UI banner: "Showing cached aggregates (stale by ~1h). Run a targeted replay to refresh." with a CTA to open the replay modal. keep wording non-technical.

linda: timeline ask: can we ship a low-risk config rollback or a parallelism cap in the next 30m? if not, revert the fast-path.

sam: i can flip replay.parallelism=1 for canary and prod in 15m, low-risk. will post when done.

kevin: follow-ups for next sprint: expose CB metrics in telemetry dashboard (cb_state, last_tripped_at, queued_count, active_replays_by_tenant), add e2e test exercising cb, and add an operator command to force-unblock.

mike: tests: run synthetic ingest load while triggering a replay to validate gating and cache fallback. i'll own the e2e.

linda: thanks all. i'll update the runbook steps and support template. ping me if SLOs still spike after the config change.

deploy-bot: deploy 326-applier patched: replay.parallelism -> 4 (canary)

ops-bot: Alert suppressed after manual cap applied to replayer cluster at 02:28.

linda: change is live. monitoring the SLA dashboard. will report back in 20m. :thumbsup:
